import datetime as dt


def main():
    # Question 1: 8-year construction starting 2005-02-23 -> ready in 2013
    start = dt.date(2005, 2, 23)
    X = start.year + 8
    print("X =", X)

    # Question 2: exact day count from 2008-03-22 to 2015-10-19
    Y = (dt.date(2015, 10, 19) - dt.date(2008, 3, 22)).days
    print("Y =", Y)

    # Question 3: whole months from 2005-06-14 to 2005-12-14
    b = dt.date(2005, 6, 14)
    t = dt.date(2005, 12, 14)
    M = (t.year * 12 + t.month) - (b.year * 12 + b.month)
    if t.day < b.day:
        M -= 1
    Z = M
    print("Z =", Z)

    Xp = X - 1992
    Yp = Y - 2756
    Zp = Z + 1873
    print("X' =", Xp, "Y' =", Yp, "Z' =", Zp)

    # Question 4 Joe's value: X'-Y'-Z' evaluated arithmetically (astronomical year)
    joe_year = Xp - Yp - Zp
    print("X'-Y'-Z' =", joe_year)

    # Keys are (year, month, day, hour, minute); tuples handle negative years exactly
    exams = {
        "Jenny": (1925, 10, 16, 0, 0),
        "Kyle": (1872, 6, 23, 5, 57),
        "Joe": (joe_year, 1, 1, 14, 46),   # year-only granularity -> Jan 1, time 14:46
        "Emma": (1944, 5, 19, 14, 33),
        "Jason": (1851, 8, 1, 0, 0),       # month-only granularity -> Aug 1, 00:00
    }
    order = sorted(exams, key=lambda n: exams[n], reverse=True)
    print("Computed descending order:", order)
    for n in order:
        print("  ", n, exams[n])

    # Submitted answer, mapped to people
    submitted_order = ["Emma", "Jenny", "Joe", "Kyle", "Jason"]

    print("Submitted Joe date:", submitted_joe)

    # Alternative reading of "21-11-1879" as dd-mm-yyyy, for comparison only
    alt_joe = (1879, 11, 21, 14, 46)
    print("Alternative dd-mm-yyyy reading of X'-Y'-Z' string:", alt_joe)

    order_ok = submitted_order == order
    joe_ok = submitted_joe == exams["Joe"]
    print("Order matches:", order_ok)
    print("Joe date matches arithmetic value:", joe_ok)
    print("Joe date matches alternative reading:", submitted_joe == alt_joe)

    if order_ok and joe_ok:
        print("CHECK PASS")
    else:
        print("CHECK FAIL")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
